title: BioRobotics Initiative: NextGen Automated AI Systems

sections.abstract: DeepGuard establishes a formal verification foundation for multi-agent deep learning systems in high-reliability operations. Our framework combines symbolic verification guarantees with state-of-the-art transformer agents.
sections.scientific_methodology: We formalize agent transitions via neural abstraction layers. Benchmark evaluations on the SafeAgent-Bench suite confirm consistent execution within mathematical bounds with zero safety invariant violations.
sections.impact_and_dissemination: Open-source release of the DeepGuard engine with Apache 2.0 license. Direct integration pilot planned with 2 European aerospace industrial partners.
sections.work_packages: WP1: Symbolic abstractions. WP2: Multi-agent protocol. WP3: Pilot industrial deployment. WP4: Dissemination.
sections.budget: Total direct personnel is €1.40M covering 120 person-months across 3 institutions. Subcontracting is strictly €200k (8.3%) for specialized formal audit. Indirect costs are exactly 25% of eligible direct costs.
